description: Source code implementing AFM support for Type 1 fonts in the FreeType project, including functions for reading font metrics, kerning pairs, and parsing PFM files.

methods.name: T1_Done_Metrics
methods.description: Frees memory associated with font metrics and resets kerning data.

methods.name: t1_get_index
methods.description: Retrieves glyph index by glyph name from font's glyph list.

methods.name: compare_kern_pairs
methods.description: Compares two kerning pairs for sorting.

methods.name: T1_Read_PFM
methods.description: Parses a PFM file to extract kerning pairs.

methods.name: T1_Read_Metrics
methods.description: Reads font metrics from AFM or PFM files.

methods.name: T1_Get_Kerning
methods.description: Retrieves kerning adjustment between two glyphs.

methods.name: T1_Get_Track_Kerning
methods.description: Calculates track kerning based on font data and point size.
